selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the traveller consider the highest human excellence and the source of all other human excellences?
questions.answer: Loving Allah, which grows out of faith in Him and knowing Him.

questions.question: What does this show about the relationship between faith and character in the passage?
questions.answer: It shows that strong faith is the foundation for true human excellence.

questions.question: How does he rank life, animate beings, and conscious beings?
questions.answer: Life is most precious, animate beings are especially valuable, and conscious beings are the highest among them.

questions.question: What does the passage say the globe is doing over time?
questions.answer: It is continually renewing its population.

questions.question: Why did he value the words of heavenly beings so highly?
questions.answer: Because testimony about the Creator from them would be especially weighty.

questions.question: What did the traveller especially hope to learn from the heavenly beings?
questions.answer: Their understanding concerning the Creator of the universe.

questions.question: Besides angels, which other group from among the unseen is mentioned as appearing before people?
questions.answer: Pure spirits.

questions.question: What role does the Qur’an have in the angels’ statement?
questions.answer: It is identified as the miraculous revelation brought by the Prophet.

questions.question: What does their total agreement add to the strength of the message?
questions.answer: It makes the message clear, firm, and hard to doubt.

questions.question: What overall role do angels play in this passage?
questions.answer: They act as witnesses from the heavenly realm confirming the truths of faith.

questions.question: What inner realization pushed the traveller to keep moving forward in faith?
questions.answer: He realized that true human excellence begins with faith-based love and knowledge of Allah.

questions.question: When he looked upward, what did he say is the most valuable thing in the universe?
questions.answer: He said life is the most valuable thing.

questions.question: What did he identify as the universe’s greatest treasure?
questions.answer: Life.

questions.question: According to the heavenly voice, what was first in the angels’ response to revelation?
questions.answer: They believed in the truths conveyed through them to the prophets.

questions.question: How is the traveller changed by hearing this?
questions.answer: His faith becomes more radiant and elevated.

questions.question: At the start of the passage, what did the traveller understand about love of Allah?
questions.answer: He understood it to be the root of human perfection and to come from faith and knowledge.

questions.question: What observation about life led him to think about the heavens?
questions.answer: He saw that life is the greatest treasure in creation and that creation seems arranged to support it.

questions.question: What did he notice about the earth from year to year and century to century?
questions.answer: He noticed that it is constantly being emptied and filled again in order to increase living beings.

questions.question: What evidence from the earth did he use in his reasoning?
questions.answer: The ongoing cycle of the world being emptied and refilled with life.

questions.question: What does the traveller wish he could do with the inhabitants of heaven?
questions.answer: Speak with them and hear what they say about the Creator.

questions.question: Why is the mention of the Companions important in this passage?
questions.answer: It shows that more than one person witnessed such events.

questions.question: What does the passage say all pure spirits who appeared to humans did without exception?
questions.answer: They all bore the same witness about Allah.

questions.question: What did the traveller believe is the source of all human perfections?
questions.answer: Love of Allah that comes from faith and knowing Him.

questions.question: What shared message do these beings proclaim?
questions.answer: That Allah exists necessarily, is One, and has sacred attributes.
